text:
The shape with three sides is a triangle.

Here is a funny anecdote based on the scenario:

Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had just watched one too many superhero origin stories. He spotted the new weight machine, which looked less like exercise equipment and more like a medieval torture device designed by a mad scientist. "Watch this," he whispered to no one in particular, adjusting his headband with the confidence of a man who had never once been defeated by inanimate objects.

He climbed in, assuming the role of the hero. The machine, however, had other plans. It didn't just resist him; it embraced him. A hydraulic hiss sounded like a disappointed sigh as Chris found himself locked in an awkward, metallic hug. He wasn't lifting weights anymore; he was being held hostage by his own hubris.

Panic set in. He flailed, not with grace, but with the dignity of a turtle flipped on its back. His eyes darted around the room, searching for the release button, which seemed to be playing a game of hide-and-seek with him. Meanwhile, a group of regulars nearby stopped their reps to watch the spectacle. One woman actually paused mid-lunge to check if she needed to call the fire department or just offer a high-five. Chris, red-faced and trapped, finally found the button, only to realize he had to press it with his elbow while trying to maintain eye contact with a mirror to ensure he didn't look *too* ridiculous. He escaped, straightened his shirt, and walked away with a limp, proving that while triangles are stable, Chris’s balance was currently in question.
